If $\lambda_{min}$ of lyman series is 915 Å, find the $\lambda_{max}$ of balmer series.
questions.solution:
$l_{min} \rightarrow$ max energy $[n = \infty \rightarrow n = 1]$
$L_{max} \rightarrow$ min energy $[n = 3 \rightarrow n = 2]$
$\frac{hc}{\lambda_{min}} = Rz^{2}\left[\frac{1}{1^{2}} - \frac{1}{\infty^{2}}\right] = Rz^{2}$
$\frac{hc}{\lambda_{max}} = Rz^{2}\left[\frac{1}{2^{2}} - \frac{1}{3^{2}}\right] = Rz^{2} \times \frac{5}{36}$
$\frac{\lambda_{min}}{\lambda_{max}} = \frac{1 \times 36}{5} \Rightarrow \lambda_{max} = \lambda_{min} \times \frac{36}{5} = \frac{915 \times 36}{5} = 6588$Å

questions.stem: If 20 division of vernier scale coincide with 19th division of main scale then find out main scale division (given 0.1 mm is the least count of vernier callipers).
questions.solution:
20 VSD = 19 MSD
1 VSD = $\frac{19}{20}$ MSD
LC = 1 MSD- 1VSD
= 1 MSD – $\frac{19}{20}$ MSD
0.1 mm = $\frac{1}{20}$ MSD
1 MSD = 2mm

$\Rightarrow ev_{s} = h\nu - \phi$
$\Rightarrow v_{s} = \left(\frac{h}{e}\right)\nu - \frac{\phi}{e}$
So, stopping potential depends on frequency of light and nature of material of metal.
Stopping potential does not depends on intensity on incident light.

questions.stem: Current flowing in a coil depends on time ‘t’ given by i = 3t + 2, where t is in sec. If induced emf in the coil is 12mV, then find self inductance (in mH) of coil.
It is given that $P \propto T^{3}$ then find the value of $\frac{C_{p}}{C_{v}}$ (process is adiabatic).
questions.solution:
$P \propto T^{3} \Rightarrow PT^{-3} = $ const
$\Rightarrow P(PV)^{-3} = $ const ($\because PV = nRT$)
$P^{-2}V^{-3} = $ const
$\Rightarrow PV^{3/2} = $ const
$\Rightarrow \gamma = \frac{3}{2} = \frac{C_{p}}{C_{v}}$

questions.stem: Why metal chain hangs at the rear part of tankers containing inflammable liquid.
questions.solution: Due to air drag charges induced on tanker, to neutralise the charge metal chains hangs at the rear part of the tankers touching with earth.

options.text: To inform other vehicles about tanker
So that extra electron can be transferred to earth.
To protect the Tyre from damage.
